profile.name: GSM短信模块
profile.description: 用于具备GSM功能的 Yoctopuce 设备的短信收发模块，可管理SIM卡短信存储槽、短信计数器、PDU数据及编码转换，并用于实验室自动化中的远程告警、状态通知和短信交互。
profile.description_en: An SMS communication module for GSM-enabled Yoctopuce devices. It manages SIM message storage slots, SMS counters, PDU data, and encoding conversion, and is used in lab automation for remote alerts, status notifications, and SMS-based interaction.
